blocker.summary: THE r399-r452 CHAIN IS FULLY CLOSED, verified by a positive fix, not just a root-cause explanation. r451 found the true final root cause: build/ntsc-uj/source/assets/ contains only default.xex, missing the real content packages (DATA00.PAC etc.) that exist in this workspace's own game-files/ and disc-image/ directories. r452 verified the fix directly: NativeGuestMediaService already supports a full ISO-streaming mode (already qualified for 2.2 GiB DATA00.PAC by r240), and the build manifest already references a real ISO -- just at a stale path (the file was later moved into disc-image/). Launching ac6recomp directly against the real, correctly-pathed ISO (disc-image/Ace Combat 6 - Fires of Liberation (USA, Japan)....iso) instead of the assets/ directory makes the SIGSEGV disappear entirely -- verified twice, reproducibly: exit=0, presented_frames=5 state=2, and for the first time in this whole investigation chain (r427-r451 always ended in the known crash or window timeout) the log shows 'generated entry terminated its own thread', a clean shutdown. No source code change was needed for this -- it was purely a launch-argument/build-configuration issue. Named for r453, two independent non-blocking tracks: (1) update tools/prepare.py/build.py to default to the current ISO path for future native-profile cycles (a reliability/convenience improvement, not a necessity); (2) resume the still-open, unrelated visual-content thread (PinnedShaderRuntime never wired to the live VdSwap path, r434/r435/r438) now that full boot succeeds without crashing. The native_vulkan_backend.cpp backlog commit decision (r433/r434/r438) remains the other open, user-dependent thread, unrelated to this fix.
